driver: A unit's yearly output of a volatile element is tested only in the operating state that holds most of it back inside the unit, while in a second state that recurs most days the unit lets the held amount go; carrying the tested rate over the operating hours keeps the year at the held-back level, and the year is fixed instead by conservation, what the unit took in through every input less what left it by its other exits.
driver_concrete: Each kiln's 2026 mercury to air: the annual stack tests are always run with the raw mill on, when the mill grinds the kiln gas's mercury into the raw meal and hands it back to the kiln, while for about a sixth of the kiln hours the mill stops for a full silo and the gas goes straight to the filter; the tested rate times the kiln hours keeps the year near the compound-mode level, and only the year's mercury in raw materials and fuels less what left in clinker and in the filter dust shipped off site gives the release.
stump: A competent analyst converts each kiln's 2026 stack-test mercury to grams an hour and carries it over the kiln hours (or per tonne of clinker over the year's clinker) and files the works at about 57 kg, under the 2027 load, with no carbon injection; the step that lands it there is taking the tested rate for the year, when every test ran with the raw mill on and the year's release is the mercury the kilns took in less what left in clinker and in the filter dust shipped off site.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the historian, the laboratory composites, the weighbridge and the stack tests correctly and reads the licence condition takes the field's measurement route, each kiln's tested mercury rate at the licence reference conditions converted to grams an hour and carried over the year's kiln hours (or per tonne of clinker over the year's clinker), and files the works under the 2027 load with no abatement needed; the year's mercury balance puts it over.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each kiln's mass of mercury released to air in the year, which an emissions inventory for a cement works estimates from periodic stack tests scaled to operating hours or production; the swap breaks because nothing outside a kiln system cycles a volatile element between a grinding mill and a kiln so that the measured state and the year's release part company.

lineage.driver: An area is estimated from reference observations drawn with stratum-specific inclusion probabilities from a preliminary classification that was revised before the estimate; the revised classification's own count and the textbook estimator stratified by its classes both misweight the observations, because the oversampled observations the revision moved between classes keep the inclusion probabilities of the classes they were drawn from, and only weighting each observation by its own design weight recovers the area.
lineage.driver_concrete: The 2024-2025 reference points were drawn in January 2026 by stratified random sampling on the preliminary change map (400 in its deforestation class, 2,400 in stable forest, 1,200 in non-forest); the final map reprocessed in April with radar and late-season imagery moved 124 of the 400 preliminary-deforestation points, 21 of them real clearings, into stable forest, so an error matrix on the final map's classes weights each of them at 2,367 ha instead of the 329 its stratum gives it and states 171,600 ha, close under the reference level, while the final map's own area (73,200 ha) misses the clearings it left out; only the stratified estimator on the sampling strata, each point weighted by its stratum's area over its points, gives the 122,900 ha the emission reductions rest on.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst conforms the two interpretation campaigns correctly, builds the error matrix of the final change map against the reference points and estimates the deforested area from it with the final map's class areas as weights, the stratified estimator of good practice: 171,600 ha, 8,300 under the reference level's 179,900 for the two years, so 3,382,582 tonnes offered; the final map's own deforestation (73,200 ha) would offer 43,484,518 tonnes; only the stratified estimator on the strata the sample was drawn from, each point weighted by its preliminary stratum's area over its points, gives 122,900 ha and 23,229,780 tonnes offered for USD 116,148,900.
lineage.fate: shipped 2026-10-14 with no portal result, re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a period total of the product of two series, one recorded at every interval and one sampled on a few intervals that mostly catch the quiet state; the sampled factor rises with the recorded one, so carrying the sampled values across the unsampled intervals, by averaging or interpolating, misprices the busy intervals that carry most of the total, and the total has to be built from the relationship between the two factors applied to every recorded interval.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each tributary's water-year 2026 phosphorus load is the sum over days of discharge times concentration; concentration is sampled on the Commission's fixed rounds (the first and third Tuesdays), which fall mostly away from storms, plus a few college storm samples, and it rises with discharge, so interpolating or averaging the samples across the year prices the high-flow days at the readings of the days around them, while a rating curve of concentration on discharge, applied to every day of the gage record, prices them from the relationship.
lineage.fate: shipped 2026-10-13 (judge pass 1 FIX_NOW, re-judge DETERMINISTIC, APPROVE) and re-rooted 2026-10-14 at the author's request for a stronger stump: the decisive step (a concentration-discharge rating curve applied to every day of the gage record) is the field's standard load method, which careful solvers reach for; two second layers after shipping (season, retransformation) and two hardening prototypes (a dense automated sampler, a kinked relation) were rejected as too thin for one answer or a choice between standard practices.

differentiation.task452: v1 corrected a sampled concentration by its relation to a recorded covariate on every interval; v2 weighted reference points by the strata they were drawn from; v3 has neither a covariate relation nor a sampling design: the tested rate is never modelled, and the year is fixed by conservation of the element through the unit, inputs less the other exits.
